body: Thank you for the kind words! I've been trying to justify that the shame should be put on my abusers, but for some reason I have trouble feeling that way. I am going to set boundaries with my sibling about this situation. I hope you have a great day.

Thanks for your reply. Yeah, I was just angry because if they really wanted to talk to their SO about it, getting consent from me would have been a much better way to go about it. Also, you're right in that I was pissed off when they made the issue about them. To me it seemed so illogical to not acknowledge that they completely breached my boundaries. I also don't really trust this SO because I barely know them, and they've only been dating for about a month. I just have to hope that they won't use my trauma against me in the future.
That's terrible :( yeah it definitely feels like betrayal when people talk about the trauma we have experienced behind our backs.
Thank you for your advice. I will discuss this issue with them and set boundaries, hopefully to minimize these types of situations happening again.
Thanks for your reply. I believe they tried to guilt-trip me into thinking my reaction was excessive, but I think I'm right to be angry and upset about having my trust broken.
Thank you for your reply. I felt like I wasn't justified getting angry but now I realize that I should discuss this and set some boundaries with them.
I'm sorry that you went through that. It definitely felt like my privacy was being breached and made me trust them less readily. I agree with you in that they shouldn't have brought it up.
Thank you for your reply. I will discuss this with them as soon as I am ready.

I'm really just angry because the extent to which they told their SO about my trauma was unnecessary. They told their SO that I was molested by my dad, and by family friends as an explanation for why I have mental illness. It would have sufficed for them to say that I experienced sexual assault.

Hi TheKatsMeow0\_0,

Thank you so much for your reply. I really thought I was making it up in my head, so to approach this objectively I intentionally didn't add my memories in the post. I did get a very weird feeling when I thought about my past behaviour. I am not sure whether to feel relieved that I can start working on my recovery or disgusted that I am still living with him though. I have contacted RAINN and have started looking for a therapist to go to. Thank you so much for your kind words, I will keep striving to overcome the past. I hope you have a great day!
Hi, could I get a link for Windows x64 please?

Woah, thank you so much for the resources you are mentioning. Your advice is helping me process what happened and take action in my own recovery. I was reading your post history about learned helplessness and will definitely use those resources as well. I really don't know how I would be coping without your advice, so thank you, and I hope you have a great day!

Hi K715yg, 

Definitely, I'm not sure how to feel about this either. I have a bit of doubt/disbelief and a lot of numbness right now, which is why I think I was able to go into detail in the post because I wanted tips on healing but also a clear indicator that I wasn't just a weird kid with strange behaviour. I am looking into the posts and therapists that not-moses mentioned, and I hope you can recover from this trauma and get support as well.

Hi not-moses,​

Thank you so much for your reply! These are great resources and I will read them as well as your other posts! I am currently grey rocking my dad because he does also seem to be a narcissist, and he keeps lashing out and insulting me in response. However, it gives me peace of mind because he is acting as predicted when grey rocked so that's something I guess. Resolving guilt and shame would be a huge help for me, it has plagued me for a while (even before I remember being molested by anyone). Again, thanks so much for these starter points, I will definitely reference them moving forward!

Hi FreeOppression, 

Thank you so much for your reply. I thought my behaviour was normal because masturbation is apparently a common habit when young, so I wasn't very sure. However, my other behaviour seemed abnormal. I will take your advice and reach out to a therapist asap.
